body: Ruling: B. Omit Propositional unless both predicates exist. Omit Entity unless the recall has at least one specified participant; with specified participants, unmatched source roles/names remain a measured mismatch. An ineligible term is absent from terms and eligible, not zero, missing, imputed, or a new regularizer. The 0.5 fallbacks currently change source-vs-external and leaf-vs-segment prices without an observation; wire already calls these undefined comparisons ineligible. Calling them priors now would relabel an unlicensed estimator. Semantic provider abstention remains imputed because that comparison was possible and attempted. Golden movement is authorized and must be reported. Pin term membership, support, and totals for predicate match/mismatch/either absent and entity match/mismatch/no specified participants. Do not compensate elsewhere; normalization/calibration and the supportOf clamp are separate.
